name: civilisation-god-mode
description: Headless tick-based human civilisation simulator with a real-time god-mode telemetry dashboard.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build && rm -rf server/public && cp -r web/dist server/public
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
